curation.lead:
Kenneth Arnold Chesney is a country music artist and entrepreneur who maintains his primary residence on St. John, US Virgin Islands, and operates a network of at least 11 corporate entities headquartered at 1505 17th Ave S, Nashville, Tennessee [Finding #6788]. His business interests span music production and touring (Arnie Barn Inc, est. 1995), recorded music (Blue Chair Records LLC), satellite radio (No Shoes Radio Inc, SiriusXM channel 59), spirits (Fishbowl Spirits LLC, maker of Blue Chair Bay Rum), and private aviation (Falcon 200 Inc) [Finding #6788][Finding #6792].

Chesney's personal asset holdings include a 1997 Dassault Falcon 900EX registered as N7KC through Falcon 200 Inc [Finding #6789], and a yacht named Gypsea, an 86-foot Riva Domino (MMSI 338239318) built in 2012 and refitted in 2022 [Finding #6790]. He has owned multiple properties on St. John, including the Stoneridge estate at Susannaberg and a property at Chocolate Hole [Finding #6793]. Following Hurricane Irma in September 2017, Chesney established the Love for Love City Foundation as a fund within Renaissance Charitable Foundation for USVI relief efforts [Finding #6793].

Chesney's corporate affairs are managed by a small team: Renee Allen serves as registered agent for eight or more entities, Robert E. Crout provides accounting services from the same Nashville address, and entertainment attorney Jess Rosen has served as agent for Arnie Barn Inc since 1995 [Finding #6794]. In March 2025, Chesney sold the Blue Chair Bay Rum brand to Next Century Spirits while retaining a major equity stake in the acquiring company [Finding #6792].
curation.system_role: Country music artist and entrepreneur with a network of Tennessee-based corporate entities spanning entertainment, spirits, and personal asset management, with residential and maritime ties to the US Virgin Islands.

sections.title: Corporate Structure
sections.content:
Chesney's business operations are organized through a constellation of entities registered in Tennessee, all sharing a principal office address at 1505 17th Ave S, Nashville, TN 37212 [Finding #6788]. The oldest surviving entity is Arnie Barn Inc, a for-profit corporation formed on July 20, 1995, which handles touring and production operations [Finding #6788]. Entertainment attorney Jess Rosen has served as its registered agent since inception [Finding #6794].

The music side of the business includes Blue Chair Records LLC (est. 2007), which holds an exclusive license with Sony Music Nashville, and No Shoes Radio Inc (est. 2009), which operates Chesney's dedicated SiriusXM satellite radio channel [Finding #6788]. Several earlier entities have been dissolved, including Kenny Chesney Merchandising LLC (1997-2000), K R D Music LLC (est. 2001), and Soul Shine Films Inc (2010-2022) [Finding #6788].

Chesney's spirits venture operated through Fishbowl Spirits LLC, a Delaware-formed entity (est. 2012) with a companion holdings LLC and foreign registrations in seven states including Tennessee, California, New York, New Mexico, South Dakota, Missouri, and Colorado [Finding #6792]. The company produced Blue Chair Bay Rum and generated approximately $5.5 million in annual revenue with around 35 employees [Finding #6792]. In March 2025, Next Century Spirits acquired the brand; Greenberg Traurig represented Chesney in the transaction, and Chesney retained a major equity position in the acquiring company [Finding #6792].

Two additional entities serve as general-purpose asset or service holding companies. NH Holdings LLC was formed on January 29, 2009, as a member-managed LLC with one to two members, and was dissolved administratively on August 9, 2022, for non-payment of Tennessee revenue tax [Finding #6791]. KC Services LLC was formed on January 12, 2022 — seven months before NH Holdings' dissolution — as a manager-managed LLC with six or fewer members [Finding #6791]. A search of Tennessee UCC filings returned no liens against either entity [Finding #6791]. The newest entity, Kenny Chesney LLC, was formed in May 2024 [Finding #6788].

sections.title: Vessels and Aviation
sections.content:
Chesney's primary yacht is the Gypsea, an 86-foot Riva Domino built in 2012 and refitted in 2022 [Finding #6790]. The vessel is US-flagged with MMSI 338239318, features a London Grey hull with Moon Grey superstructure, and was previously named Vibe Room before Chesney acquired and renamed it [Finding #6790]. A Facebook post from Global Yacht Detailing Inc, a Miami-based marine service company, directly tagged Chesney as the owner [Finding #6790]. As of March 2026, the Gypsea was listed for sale at EUR 4.495 million through RU Yachts [Finding #6790].

Chesney has owned a succession of vessels over a two-decade period. His first boat, the Hey Now, was a Sea Ray acquired around 2001 that he credited with launching his island lifestyle [Finding #6795]. He subsequently owned a 45-foot Sea Ray named 6th Gear, which appeared in his 2002 music video for "No Shirt, No Shoes, No Problem" and was later sold to a charter company in the USVI, where it operates as Take It Easy out of Saga Haven Marina on St. Thomas [Finding #6795]. Additional vessels included 56-foot and 60-foot Sea Ray Express Cruisers and a 63-foot Riva Virtus, the latter confirmed in a February 2017 sighting off Fort Lauderdale [Finding #6795].

Chesney's aircraft is a 1997 Dassault Falcon 900EX (serial number 14), a tri-engine jet with 21 seats registered as N7KC [Finding #6789]. The N-number combines his high school football jersey number (7) with his initials (KC) [Finding #6789]. The aircraft is held by Falcon 200 Inc, a Tennessee corporation formed June 3, 2005, named after his original jet, a 1983 Dassault Falcon 200 [Finding #6789]. The Falcon 900EX was acquired from American International Group (AIG) in February 2009 and re-registered under the N7KC tail number in May 2009 [Finding #6789].

sections.title: US Virgin Islands Presence
sections.content:
Chesney has maintained a residential presence on St. John, USVI, since the early 2000s, owning multiple properties on the island [Finding #6793]. His holdings have included the Stoneridge estate at Susannaberg, a 7-bedroom, 10,600-square-foot property overlooking Caneel Bay that was listed at $14 million [Finding #6793]. He purchased a home at Estate Peter Bay for $3.3 million in 2003, later selling it for $4.4 million [Finding #6793]. Additional properties include Villa Sunspot (since sold) and a property at Chocolate Hole that he reportedly continues to own [Finding #6793].

Following Hurricane Irma's devastation of St. John in September 2017, Chesney established the Love for Love City Foundation to support relief and recovery efforts [Finding #6793]. The foundation operates as a fund within Renaissance Charitable Foundation Inc, a 501(c)(3) public charity, rather than as a standalone corporate entity [Finding #6793]. Chesney also maintains a separate 501(c)(3) private foundation, the Kenny Chesney Foundation Inc (EIN 20-3996727), incorporated in Tennessee in December 2005 [Finding #6788].

sections.title: Key Personnel
sections.content:
Chesney's business operations are administered by a small group of professionals operating from 1505 17th Ave S in Nashville [Finding #6794]. Renee Allen serves as the registered agent for eight or more Chesney entities, including Falcon 200 Inc, Kenny Chesney Foundation Inc, Blue Chair Records LLC, No Shoes Radio Inc, KC Services LLC, and Kenny Chesney LLC [Finding #6794]. She assumed the agent role for NH Holdings LLC in 2023, replacing the original agent Robert E. Crout [Finding #6791].

Robert E. Crout is a certified public accountant operating from the same 1505 17th Ave S address [Finding #6794]. His CPA practice, founded in 2009, employs approximately three people and generates roughly $300,000 in annual revenue [Finding #6794]. Crout served as the registered agent for NH Holdings LLC from its formation in January 2009 through 2023 [Finding #6791].

Jess Rosen, an entertainment attorney, has served as the registered agent for Arnie Barn Inc since the company's founding in 1995 [Finding #6794]. Greenberg Traurig represented Chesney in the March 2025 sale of Blue Chair Bay Rum to Next Century Spirits [Finding #6792]. Steve Marshall works at Arnie Barn Inc in a production and touring capacity [Finding #6794].
